extracted.intended_audience: local and national media/journalists covering Salvation Army Southern Nevada
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational media center page describing how The Salvation Army Southern Nevada supports and interacts with the press, including services offered, typical news topics, and a contact for media inquiries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media relations staff availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Every territory and division throughout the country has media relations staff available to assist you.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use local/division media relations staff to help localize stories and coordinate communications; the page emphasizes that media relations personnel are available across the organization to assist reporters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opportunities to localize news
rubrics_metrics.description: For media, this means a variety of opportunities to localize news.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples of story angles to localize include disaster relief for area wildfires, feeding the community’s hungry, sheltering the homeless, and mentoring at-risk children — topics the organization highlights as media opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Highlighting newsworthy items and topical issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Throughout the course of any given year, newsworthy items and topical issues are highlighted through our social service programs and special events - many of which involve local leaders and dignitaries, the entertainment community, and other noted supporters of the work being done by The Salvation Army.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The organization proactively surfaces programs and events likely to be newsworthy, often involving notable local figures; reporters can expect such items to be promoted for coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to timely communication
rubrics_metrics.description: We are committed to keeping the media informed. We do this through alerting, advising and providing timely communication concerning the important year-round activities of The Salvation Army throughout Southern Nevada.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Salvation Army frames responsiveness as a service: expect alerts, advisories, and timely information about activities and events relevant to reporters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilitation of expert sources
rubrics_metrics.description: We can also facilitate the provision of experts in a variety of social service fields.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reporters seeking subject-matter experts (e.g., on homelessness, hunger, disaster response, youth mentoring) can request facilitation through the media contacts provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact procedure and point person
rubrics_metrics.description: For more information, please contact: Michelle Senser, Public Relations Director, The Salvation Army Southern Nevada; michelle.senser@usw.salvationarmy.org; (725) 777-1365.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the listed PR director contact (email/phone) for media inquiries, to request experts, or to coordinate coverage of events and programs.
